^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$.description: A metadata value string keyed by alphanumeric/underscore name.

metadata.description: Generic key-value store for extra context (e.g., source, impact, legacy output).

kebabId.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier used as the universal ID format across all spec artifacts (e.g., 'fr-user-login', 'api-session-create').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time string used for artifact creation and modification timestamps.

owner.description: Artifact owner — validated against canon/kinds/owner.json entries.

tag.description: Short alphanumeric label used for categorization and filtering of canonical entries (max 64 chars).

screamingSnakeId.description: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE identifier used for constants and task identifiers in implementation artifacts.

milestoneStatus.description: Progress status for milestones: pending (not started), in_progress, done, or deferred.

severityLevel.description: Severity or risk level used across threat assessments, milestone risk ratings, and review findings.

httpMethod.description: Standard HTTP methods for REST API interface contracts.

httpMethodFull.description: Extended HTTP method set including OPTIONS and HEAD for scaffold interface mappings.

componentType.description: Architectural component type classification in system sketches.

connectionProtocol.description: Inter-component connection protocol in system sketches.

apiProtocol.description: API-level communication protocol for interface contracts.

trustBoundary.description: Trust boundary classification for inter-component connections.

connectionAuth.description: Authentication mechanism for inter-component connections in system sketches.

apiSecurity.description: Security mechanism for API interface contracts.

threatCategory.description: Threat category classification for red team assessments.

messageReliability.description: Message delivery guarantee level for event-driven connections.
